callees.name: _iter_project_source_files
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a string path to an existing directory. submodules is either None or a non-empty list of subdirectory names.
callees.post_condition: Yields (abs_path, rel_path) tuples for every source file under proj_dir that is not a test file. When submodules is not None, yields only files whose relative path begins with one of the submodule directory names. Terminates after yielding all matching files; yields zero tuples when no files match.
